_about: Keyless reputation feeds Amass matches the IP addresses and netblocks an enumeration reaches against. Each feed is downloaded at most once per refresh_hours (a feed's own terms set the floor: Spamhaus asks for no more than one download an hour) and kept on disk, at most max_bytes. A feed's format is ndjson_cidr (one JSON object per line, its cidr field the listed range; Spamhaus DROP) or lines (one address or range per line, # starting a comment; the Tor exit list and FireHOL netsets). Reserved and private ranges a feed lists (FireHOL level 1 lists the bogons) are skipped, so in-house space is never flagged. A listed asset gets the reputation_listing property, the feed's name. A listing describes the address, not who runs it: it is never ownership evidence. The exposure lens reports the organization's listed addresses and netblocks.
